intro: Singapore is a parliamentary republic where one party, the People's Action Party, has governed since 1959.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; Lawrence Wong took over in 2024. The president is elected but mainly ceremonial. Elections are clean but critics say the rules favour the ruling party.

chapters.title: Strict rules
text: Singapore is known for strict laws, such as fines for littering and limits on chewing gum, and for very low crime.
